summary: @onereach/cb-schema-translator preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs fingerprints the platform (including an Alpine/musl detection via ldd and /etc/os-release), downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip` into a temporary directory, unpacks it, chmods it executable, and then invokes the downloaded Bun binary against a shipped 727KB single-line file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (rotated string-array cipher `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers, numeric character-code array, custom base decoder `hc1jfK9`), so its behavior is not readable from the source and executes outside Node under an alternate runtime that Node-based tooling does not observe. setup.mjs itself uses the same obfuscation style (hex identifiers, dispatcher property tables). The package's advertised purpose is converting a schema to email HTML and does not require a second language runtime or a large opaque payload; the plain src/ code is a façade in front of the dropper.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
